description: A sign-in, as its host has it: a chat's to Claude, from which every head draws the chat's sign-in card alone (LoginCard), whichever head started what's going on; or a Codex account's device-code sign-in in Subscriptions (accounts sign_in's login), from which the head that asked draws its card.

state.description: needed: a turn failed for want of signing in (and every sign-in started since was cancelled); signing_in: claude auth login (codex login --device-auth) runs on the host for it; signed_in: it finished; failed: it ended without signing in.

url.description: signing_in, a Codex device-code sign-in's: the page to open, once codex has said it.

code.description: signing_in, a Codex device-code sign-in's: the one-time code to enter on that page.

expired.description: needed because the sign-in there was ran out (expired, reached its time limit, can't be renewed), not because there's none.

reason.description: needed: the first sentence of Claude's own error; failed: why the sign-in didn't finish.

who.description: signed_in: who as, as claude auth status says it (Codex's: the email its sign-in names); null if it didn't say, or the head may not read Subscriptions.

turn.description: needed: which of the chat's turns that failed for want of signing in it's for, counted on its host since it started: a new one each time one fails, so every head moves the card to that turn.
